External projection weights and attention kernels are not evaluated offline; retained tensors and source-selection descriptors are audited.

Color regions use uncalibrated red/blue hue thresholds; novel green/yellow objects may be unknown, never scored as scientific failure.
The resolver is a small development-neighbor empirical predictor; every heldout reference and branch remains visible, including abstentions and misses.
The full-array audit ran on the storage host; compact custody binds it and original PNGs, not a local full-array re-audit.
Zero native entries during prediction phases; edited RGB is observed native continuation, not independently forecast pixels.
Paired selection chose fixed RA twice; recipient-only abstained once and chose RA once. No action improvement established.
Queued canceled job is pre-execution null evidence; corrected completed job is the sole model execution.

Visual resemblance does not establish byte equality, object-program identity, unit necessity or a universal route.
A match or counterexample below concerns the explicitly named qualitative ordering analogue. Predeclared numeric p rankings cannot be verified or refuted solely from these images.
All attention-support variants retain their declared fixed-R context. The fixed-R control already changes red-block shape; that collateral must not be attributed uniquely to K/V.
Rescue comparisons change later own-state image rows. A displayed relation rescue is not evidence that every other part of the scene was restored.
Assistant inspection, not calibrated object-level certification.
Left/right ordering is clearer than exact primitive geometry.
New seed and third-object context vary together across pairs; this is not an isolated arity-effect experiment.
